content.title: Academics
content.text: Choose from over 100 degrees and disciplines, from associate to PhD, in disciplines and careers from the traditional liberal arts and sciences — biology to philosophy — engineering, nursing, criminal justice, psychology, computer science, electronic filmmaking and digital design, communication studies, fine arts, among many others. Majors and Programs Study throughout New Jersey and around the world Fairleigh Dickinson University offers a wide range of academic programs on four campuses. Courses and full degree programs are also available at more than 100 locations around the State of New Jersey; and through online courses accessible from anywhere in the world. Explore Majors & Programs Gain an Academic Edge with FDU FDU provides its students with a variety of different learning experiences that will teach, challenge and prepare you for a lifetime of success. Our classes are small and personal, and give you the opportunity to better connect with your professors and other students. Every class is taught by an experienced, engaged professor, and we emphasize experiential learning, which we believe better prepares students for the real world. Schools and Colleges One of Fairleigh Dickinson University’s greatest strengths is the flexibility and range of study offered by our distinct colleges and schools. View All Schools and Colleges Libraries Extensive Resources for FDU Students The Library is home to rich collections, dedicated staff and skilled librarians to help you succeed with your studies as a student at any one of our four locations, including the FDU Digital Archives.
